text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Debut race. Having declared 
her intent to conquer the Tiara route, her 
race drew a massive amount of attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer tries to ease her first-race 
jitters by speaking to Mejiro Ramonu, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was exhilarated by the pure joy of 
loving racing. The Trainer watched her 
back in awe... Wondering if the day would 
ever come when they could truly understand 
her.
